messages:
lucas: heads-up: planning a coordinated change across ts/go sdks to surface routing affinity hints as a first-class param, not just headers. goal: cleaner developer ergonomics + less proxy-side parsing.
anita: can you sketch the API? we need to ensure console can map affinity to quota buckets.
lucas: concept: `affinity: {strategy: 'sticky'|'session'|'none', key: 'user_id', ttl_secs: 3600}` passed on requests. sdks would set X-RW-AFFINITY header as compact proto only when strategy!='none'.
grace: console/quotas: we need canonical fields. require `strategy` and `key`. server will reject unknown `strategy` values.
lucas: agreed. example ts usage:
```ts
client.generate({ prompt, affinity: { strategy: 'sticky', key: 'tenant_123' } })
```
owen: impact on quota enforcement? if affinity pins requests to a shard, our quota counters must still reflect tenant usage overall. we can
void double-counting but ensure aggregation across shards.
anita: infra note: proxy currently extracts free-form affinity from headers. moving to typed affinity lets us drop brittle heuristics. but need to support legacy header for 8 weeks.
grace: UX: in console add a new line in route detail: "Affinity: sticky (key=user_id)" and a hint bubble explaining how it affects batching and cost. also show "affinity coverage" metric.
lucaS: (typo) lucas: will open a short RFC. staging plan: 1) sdk change in ts/go with compat shim, 2) proxy accepts new header and maps to route shard but still increments global counters, 3) console adds coverage and explainer, 4) dep notice and remove legacy acceptance.
build-bot: go-sdk 1.8.0-alpha and ts-sdk 3.2.0-alpha published at 2026-04-08T10:12:00Z
owen: one tricky thing: session strategy needs stable key entropy. if clients give high-cardinality keys we could blow up shard map. add client-side lint and server-side cardinality guard.
anita: yep enforce server: if unique keys > 100k per tenant/day, return 400 and log. we should also surface a console alert.
grace: console: when alarm fires show "Affinity cardinality high: potential mapping blowout" with quick link to docs.
lucas: backwards compat: sdk will still accept `affinityHeader` in options and convert. warn with DeprecationWarning for go; console will show translation used in metrics history.
owen: telemetry interaction: if telemetry sampling suppresses headers, affinity info may be lost. need to ensure affinity header is never considered PII and is allowed when telemetry suppressed.
anita: legal says affinity key could be PII (user_id). we need a policy: default SDK will hash keys with salt before sending unless explicit opt-out by customer. add env var `RW_AFFINITY_RAW=true` to disable hashing.
lUCAS: lucas: good catch. update API docs: affinity.key must be either plaintext id or hashed with `sha256(key + sdk_salt)`. SDK will hash by default.
grace: console should show whether affinity keys are hashed in telemetry (privacy indicator).
build-bot: noted: privacy change requires a blog blurb and updated SDK changelog.
owen: testing: unit for header serialization, integration with proxy shard mapping, stress test for cardinality, and an e2e showing console coverage.
anita: rollout window: canary -> opt-in orgs -> default on for new SDK versions after 3 weeks. we will keep legacy header accepted for 8 weeks then start emitting deprecation warnings in logs.
lucas: thanks. I'll draft the RFC and PRs. tagging @eng-platform for header name finalization (X-RW-AFFINITY suggested).
grace: sounds good. please add a short FAQ in dev-ex docs about hashing behavior and quota effects.
owen: ack. no blockers from infra aside from cardinality threshold tuning.
anita: i'll coordinate docs + console tile copy.
lucas: posting RFC link to #devex-resources after this thread.
